package db

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/ydb-platform/ydb-go-sdk/v3/query"
)

type failure struct{}

func (*failure) Error() string { return "test failure" }

type stream struct {
	query.Result
	query.ResultSet
	count, read, sets, closed                                   int
	executeErr, firstErr, nextErr, scanErr, finishErr, closeErr error
	extra, canceledOnClose                                      bool
}

func (s *stream) Query(context.Context, string, ...query.ExecuteOption) (query.Result, error) {
	return s, s.executeErr
}
func (s *stream) Exec(context.Context, string, ...query.ExecuteOption) error {
	panic("unexpected Exec")
}
func (s *stream) QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...query.ExecuteOption) (query.Row, error) {
	panic("unexpected QueryRow")
}
func (s *stream) NextResultSet(ctx context.Context) (query.ResultSet, error) {
	s.sets++
	if s.sets == 1 {
		if s.firstErr != nil {
			return nil, s.firstErr
		}
		return s, nil
	}
	if s.finishErr != nil {
		return nil, s.finishErr
	}
	if s.extra {
		return s, nil
	}
	return nil, io.EOF
}
func (s *stream) NextRow(context.Context) (query.Row, error) {
	if s.read == s.count {
		if s.nextErr != nil {
			return nil, s.nextErr
		}
		return nil, io.EOF
	}
	s.read++
	return testRow{s: s}, nil
}
func (s *stream) Close(ctx context.Context) error {
	s.closed++
	s.canceledOnClose = ctx.Err() != nil
	return s.closeErr
}

type testRow struct {
	query.Row
	s *stream
}

func (r testRow) ScanNamed(dst ...query.NamedDestination) error {
	if r.s.scanErr != nil {
		return r.s.scanErr
	}
	*dst[0].Ref().(*uint64) = uint64(r.s.read)
	if r.s.read%2 == 1 {
		name := strings.Repeat("x", 64<<10)
		*dst[1].Ref().(**string) = &name
	}
	return nil
}
func TestSequentialBoundedConsumption(t *testing.T) {
	s := &stream{count: 4096}
	q := New(s)
	runtime.GC()
	var before runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	calls := 0
	err := q.Visit(context.Background(), func(row VisitRow) error {
		calls++
		if s.read != calls || row.ID != uint64(calls) || (row.Name == nil) != (calls%2 == 0) {
			t.Fatalf("read ahead or incorrect row: %d %+v", s.read, row)
		}
		if calls%512 == 0 {
			runtime.GC()
			var now runtime.MemStats
			runtime.ReadMemStats(&now)
			if now.HeapAlloc > before.HeapAlloc+16<<20 {
				t.Fatalf("retained result rows: %d bytes", now.HeapAlloc-before.HeapAlloc)
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil || calls != 4096 || s.closed != 1 || s.canceledOnClose {
		t.Fatalf("calls=%d close=%d canceled=%v err=%v", calls, s.closed, s.canceledOnClose, err)
	}
}
func TestFailuresAndCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	original := &failure{}
	cleanup := errors.New("cleanup")
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		setup  func(*stream)
		want   error
		calls  int
		closed int
	}{
		{"empty", func(s *stream) { s.count = 0 }, nil, 0, 1},
		{"execute", func(s *stream) { s.executeErr = original }, original, 0, 0},
		{"no sets", func(s *stream) { s.firstErr = io.EOF }, query.ErrNoResultSets, 0, 1},
		{"first", func(s *stream) { s.firstErr = original }, original, 0, 1},
		{"iteration", func(s *stream) { s.nextErr = original }, original, 2, 1},
		{"decode", func(s *stream) { s.scanErr = original }, original, 0, 1},
		{"finish", func(s *stream) { s.finishErr = original }, original, 2, 1},
		{"extra", func(s *stream) { s.extra = true }, query.ErrMoreThanOneResultSet, 2, 1},
		{"close", func(s *stream) { s.closeErr = original }, original, 2, 1},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := &stream{count: 2}
			tc.setup(s)
			calls := 0
			err := New(s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { calls++; return nil })
			if !errors.Is(err, tc.want) || calls != tc.calls || s.closed != tc.closed {
				t.Fatalf("calls=%d closed=%d err=%v", calls, s.closed, err)
			}
			if err != nil && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "(*Queries).Visit") {
				t.Fatalf("missing method stack: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
	s := &stream{count: 2, closeErr: cleanup}
	err := New(s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { return original })
	var typed *failure
	if !errors.Is(err, original) || !errors.Is(err, cleanup) || !errors.As(err, &typed) || s.read != 1 || s.closed != 1 || !s.canceledOnClose {
		t.Fatalf("callback failure: %v %+v", err, s)
	}
}
func TestCancellationNilAndPanic(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s := &stream{count: 2}
	err := New(s).Visit(ctx, func(VisitRow) error { cancel(); return nil })
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || s.read != 1 || s.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("cancel: %v %+v", err, s)
	}
	if err := New(nil).Visit(ctx, func(VisitRow) error { return nil }); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := New(nil).Visit(context.Background(), nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil callback accepted")
	}
	s = &stream{count: 2}
	sentinel := &failure{}
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() != sentinel {
				t.Fatal("panic changed")
			}
		}()
		_ = New(s).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { panic(sentinel) })
	}()
	if s.read != 1 || s.closed != 1 || !s.canceledOnClose {
		t.Fatalf("panic leaked result: %+v", s)
	}
}

// The generated method must use exactly the executor supplied to New, leaving
// materialization, session acquisition and transaction boundaries with callers.
type client struct {
	query.Client
	s *stream
}

func (c client) Query(ctx context.Context, sql string, opts ...query.ExecuteOption) (query.Result, error) {
	return c.s.Query(ctx, sql, opts...)
}
func (c client) Do(context.Context, query.Operation, ...query.DoOption) error {
	panic("unexpected session acquisition")
}

type session struct {
	query.Session
	s *stream
}

func (s session) Query(ctx context.Context, sql string, opts ...query.ExecuteOption) (query.Result, error) {
	return s.s.Query(ctx, sql, opts...)
}

type transaction struct {
	query.TxActor
	s *stream
}

func (tx transaction) Query(ctx context.Context, sql string, opts ...query.ExecuteOption) (query.Result, error) {
	return tx.s.Query(ctx, sql, opts...)
}
func TestUsesSuppliedExecutor(t *testing.T) {
	for _, constructor := range []func(*stream) DBTX{
		func(s *stream) DBTX { return client{s: s} },
		func(s *stream) DBTX { return session{s: s} },
		func(s *stream) DBTX { return transaction{s: s} },
	} {
		for _, callbackErr := range []error{nil, &failure{}} {
			s := &stream{count: 3}
			calls := 0
			err := New(constructor(s)).Visit(context.Background(), func(VisitRow) error { calls++; return callbackErr })
			wantCalls := 3
			if callbackErr != nil {
				wantCalls = 1
			}
			if !errors.Is(err, callbackErr) || calls != wantCalls || s.closed != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v calls=%d closed=%d", err, calls, s.closed)
			}
		}
	}
}
